name: Catalina Lutheran Church

pastors.name: Michael Morehouse
pastors.notes: The Rev. Dr. Michael Morehouse; senior pastor here since 12 July 1998. Retired US Army chaplain; 1st Vice President of the LCMS English District as of 2025.

pastors.name: Bruce von Hindenburg
pastors.notes: Called as Assistant Pastor in 2024; also provides pulpit supply across the Arizona South Circuit and serves as its Circuit Visitor through 2028. The church staff page refers to him only as 'Rev. von Hindenburg'; the first name Bruce comes from his own LinkedIn profile, so double-check it against a church bulletin before publishing.

notes: Confessional LCMS parish (English District) in the Catalina area north of Oro Valley. Address 15855 N Twin Lakes Drive is confirmed on the church's own site, which gives the city as Tucson AZ 85739 - that ZIP is the Catalina post office. Coordinates not set - run tools/geocode.py. TWO CALLED PASTORS, so per-sermon attribution matters: Rev. Dr. Michael Morehouse (Senior Pastor since 1998) and Rev. von Hindenburg (Assistant Pastor since 2024). CAUTION ON THE ASSISTANT PASTOR'S NAME: the church's staff page never prints his first name; 'Bruce' comes from his LinkedIn profile and should be re-verified from a bulletin or the LCMS roster before the name is published. The church also has a VICARAGE PROGRAM - a vicar (listed on the staff page for 2026-2027 only as 'Vicar Hyde') and three deacons (Tom Honebrink, Timothy Dinkel, Roni Grad). A vicar preaches during his year, so some sermons in the archive will not be by either called pastor; check the title or the bulletin for each. Sermons are posted both as blog entries (listen/read) and on YouTube (@catalinalutheranchurch-tuc5982); the written sermon posts may be the easiest corpus and are also the place to check for printed attribution. Lutheran preaching follows a lectionary, so expect elevated baseline overlap with published lectionary sermon helps; account for that.
